beliefs: f deletes an uppercase 'B' whenever it is immediately followed by 'O' or 'o' (so 'BOM'->'OM', 'Bom'->'om', 'BOm'->'Om', 'BoM'->'oM') [E6, E7]
Lowercase 'b' is never deleted: 'bOM','bOm','bom' are unchanged [E6, E7]
Deletion is applied repeatedly until stable, so 'BBOM'->'BOM'->'OM' and 'BOMBOMBOM'->'OMOMOM' [E8]
Deletion happens anywhere in the string, including between letters/symbols: 'xBOMy'->'xOMy', 'XBOM'->'XOM', 'BOM!'->'OM!' [E9]
'BOOM'->'OOM' confirms the rule is 'B followed by O/o' (not requiring M immediately after) [E9]
U+FEFF is left intact and does not block deletion: '\ufeffBOM start'->'\ufeffOM start' [E4, E5]
Deletion is not left-to-right single-pass: 'BOB'->'O' shows the B after the O is also deleted after the first B is removed, so re-scanning the whole string each round is required [E10]
The rule fires for any uppercase B followed by O or o, including 'BOb'->'Ob', 'BoB'->'o', 'Bob'->'ob', 'BOBOB'->'OO', 'BObOB'->'ObO', 'BObO'->'ObO', 'BOBOBO'->'OOO' [E11]
'bOB'->'bO' confirms lowercase b is not deleted but the uppercase B after it is [E11]
